flows.title: Create an event in your group
steps: Open your group's Calendar tab and click the plus button. The Add event window opens, and its auto-fill formats can fill the details in quickly.
Set the Title, keeping it short, then the Date the event starts, the Time, the Duration — anything from 30 minutes to 24 hours — and the Timezone if it needs changing.

For a repeating event, check Recurring Event and choose whether it repeats daily, weekly, monthly or annually and on which day of the week, and whether it never ends, ends on a specific day or ends after a number of occurrences.
Location defaults to Skool Call. Zoom or Meet can be chosen instead, or a physical address for an in-person meetup.
Add a short description with any relevant instructions. For a cover image, click Upload cover image, choose an image, crop it as necessary, and then click ADD.

flows.title: Create a course in the Classroom
steps: Go to the Classroom tab in your group.
Add a course name, a description and a cover photo, and set who can access the course. All of it can be changed later.
Courses are published by default. To hide one from members, use the green toggle to put it back to draft; a draft course shows an icon in its upper left corner and appears with reduced opacity.
